Everything a Wrestling Program Needs

Sublimated Singlets

The classic one-piece cut in 4-way stretch lycra. All-over sublimated design with school colors, mascot and lettering printed into the fabric - no vinyl to peel off on the mat.

Two-Piece Uniforms

NFHS-legal compression top and fight shorts, sized as a matched set. Increasingly the choice for high school programs where athletes prefer the coverage.

Fight Shorts & Compression Tops

Sold separately for programs that already have singlets: split or straight hem shorts, short and long-sleeve compression tops in matching colorways.

Zip jackets, joggers and travel hoodies in team colors, so the squad arrives at a dual meet looking like one program.

Why Wrestling Programs Order Factory-Direct

Wrestling is one of the few sports where the uniform is the equipment. A singlet that bags out at the shoulders or loses its print after ten washes is a problem every match, and most programs are buying from a reseller who ordered it offshore anyway - with the markup layered on top.

Ordering direct means the sublimation is dyed into the fibre rather than printed on top, the lycra is specified by weight rather than whatever came cheapest, and a 20-piece minimum covers a varsity squad with spares. Mixed youth-to-adult sizing in one run is standard, not an exception. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom wrestling singlets?

20 pieces per design, which covers a varsity squad with spares. Youth through adult sizes can be mixed freely in the same order at no surcharge.

Can you make two-piece wrestling uniforms instead of singlets?

Yes. We produce NFHS-legal two-piece sets - a compression top with matching fight shorts - sublimated from the same artwork as a singlet, at the same 20-set minimum.

How much does a custom wrestling singlet cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Comparable sublimated garment baselines on our published pricing page run $15-18 at team quantities, falling with volume; singlets sit at the lower end because of the fabric area involved.

What fabric do you use for singlets?

Four-way stretch poly-spandex or nylon-lycra at 200-240 GSM - heavy enough to hold its shape through a season, with flatlock seams that will not chafe during a six-minute match.

How long does a wrestling order take?

Free design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days - comfortably inside a pre-season window.
